motivation.title: Goal
motivation.text: A chatbot which runs locally and answers with provided information

PWA.title: Langchain + llama.cpp
text: After a short research I decided to use langchain in combination with llama.cpp to run the llms locally.
llama.cpp allows only the gguf format which allows us to use only the CPU for the llm instead of the gpu

Firebase.title: ChromaDB
text: To store the knowledge which is provided by the bot, I used the chromaDB. This is a database which creates vectors out of phrases. So onse the user inserts something into chat it generates a vector and searches for similar entries insde chroma.
Once it finds those similarities it can provide the correct phrases which we can use in our prompt to generate an answer based on the provided information

Vue.title: Flask
text: I used Flask to create access to the chatbot and provide it as an HTTP service.
